files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
- Add highlighted Russian search results with previous/next navigation and one-click clearing.
- Add chapter-title and chapter-description search with direct timeline seeking.
- Add deterministic chapter-quality metrics for timeline coverage, speech coverage, gaps, repetition, placeholders and lexical relevance.
- Log quality measurements after every completed pipeline run and add regression coverage.
